title: Metal–organic framework-based gas sensors: fabrication, mechanisms, and applications
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, 55,1561-1614
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00472A, Review Article
Jianzhong Zheng, Yuxuan Xie, Wen-Hua Li, Qiaomei Sun, Siqi Li, Yaling Liu, Zhaoxiang Zhong, Zhiyong Tang, Dan Zhao
Recent advances in MOF-based gas sensors are reviewed, covering fabrication, mechanisms, and applications (chemiresistive, FET, Kelvin probe, capacitive, optical), including chiral recognition and flexible devices, with challenges and outlook.
